Chapter 6117: No War

Chapter 6117: No War

The woman on the donkey emitted no aura and momentum. However, the refreshing feeling emanating from her could split imperial auras apart.

“Who is she? She dared to challenge Transcendent Emperor.” Someone whispered.

Everyone knew only primal ancestors could defeat Transcendent Emperor, so who was this woman? Was she ignorant or crazy?

“Fellow Daoist Chu Zhu.” Transcendent, unlike the rest of the crowd, seemed glad to see her: “I was inferior when we last met, shall we try again?”

“What?!” Everyone couldn’t believe it. Only Ghost Ancestor and Immortal Suppressor were stronger than him in Sin.

This seemingly weak woman had defeated him before? All eyes were on her as they tried to guess her identity.

The answer came right after as the emperors from Enigma bowed and greeted her: “Secret Ancestor.”

She was none other than Chu Zhu, the descendant of the Chu.

“Secret Ancestor of Enigma?” Jaws dropped to the ground.

Only Strategy Ancestor was known to be active despite rarely leaving Enigma. At the very least, people knew of Strategy and had seen the cultivator before.

Secret and Hidden Ancestor were unknown to Sin and even Enigma. The members of Enigma had never seen the two before.

Today, everyone finally met Secret Ancestor.

“How strong is she?” A big shot asked. Transcendent Emperor himself admitted losing to her before.

Where did she learn her dao? Why did she not show up all this time?

“Would Hidden Ancestor be stronger or weaker than her?” A desolate god wondered.

“The character

secret

comes before

hidden

. Does that mean Hidden Ancestor is as strong as Immortal Suppressor?” Someone whispered. [1]

“It can’t be, our Sin has two primal ancestors?” Another disagreed.

They speculated Hidden Ancestor was above Secret Ancestor. If Secret Ancestor could defeat an emperor on the limit path, then Hidden Ancestor should be in the primal realm.

“So Enigma is actually this strong?” One ancestor took a deep breath.

“They are actually competitive if they have a primal ancestor.” A big shot murmured.

“The limit path, the number one genius indeed.” Chu Zhu said while staring at Transcendent.

“You are also on the limit path, a rival of mine.” Transcendent said.

“It took me more time to get here, so I am not as talented.” She said.

Her humble words stirred the crowd since this confirmed her cultivation.

“I’m afraid I will have to kill you in due time.” He spoke the truth for his talent was as clear as day. Humility coming from him was nothing more than a sham.

“So is it time for war? We are prepared.” Chu Zhu said.

“It is not.” A middle-aged man appeared inside Darkmoon Temple and spoke calmly.

His presence removed all the imperial auras, leaving behind a clear sky. The uncomfortable heat and chill waves disappeared from the market.

“Tranquility Emperor!” Everyone lowered their head upon seeing him; some prostrated to display the highest reverence.

The brilliant Transcendent also bowed to show his respect.

“Our two dynasties are in control of numerous lives. There is no true feud between us in this generation, an all-out war shouldn’t be waged on a whim.” He said.

1. Enigma comprises two characters, secret and hidden. They almost have the same meaning. ☜
